configurations.//: Port 5173, the same as the jarvis command, because that is the port jarvis remote shares with the iPhone: started on any other port, the phone shows "Can't reach your Mac". autoPort is off for the same reason, and because the bridge only accepts WebSocket origins on localhost:5173-5199 and 4173-4199. If JARVIS is already running, npm start joins that copy instead of starting a second.
configurations.name: jarvis
configurations.//writes: --writes lets JARVIS act (files, shell, browser, phone), the same as the jarvis command, which starts in write mode. Remove it for a read-only start.
